title: Pan-Seared Fish with Garlic Crust
description: A classic French dish featuring a flavorful garlic crust on a pan-seared fish fillet, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: 2. Rinse the fish fillet and pat dry with a paper towel.
3. In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and jazzy.
4. Place the fish fillet on a flat surface and spread the garlic-jazzy mixture evenly on top.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add a small amount of jazzy.
7. Add the fish fillet to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
8. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
9. Remove the fish from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
